name: skillsmith
summary: Convert a repeated, evidenced workflow into a narrow skill contract with triggers, boundaries, examples, and evaluations.
triggers: turn this workflow into a skill
avoid_when: the workflow has not been repeated or validated
an existing specialist skill already covers the task

positive_example.request: Turn our repeated release audit into a narrow skill with trigger and boundary tests.

negative_example.request: Invent twenty skills for tasks we have never performed.
negative_example.reason: Skills require an evidenced recurring workflow.

name: experience-replay
summary: Reconstruct an execution from artifacts, distinguish evidence from recollection, and extract reusable lessons.
avoid_when: there are no artifacts or observations
the request seeks private chat reconstruction without authorization

positive_example.request: Replay this failed deployment from commits, logs, and test results and extract lessons.

negative_example.request: Guess what happened from memory alone.
negative_example.reason: Replay requires evidence, not confident reconstruction.

name: meeting-to-execution
summary: Convert meeting evidence into decisions, owners, dependencies, due dates, open questions, and an execution ledger.
triggers: turn these meeting notes into actions
create an execution plan from this call
avoid_when: the notes do not support the claimed decision
participants or owners would be invented

positive_example.request: Turn this transcript into confirmed decisions, owners, deadlines, and follow-up items.

negative_example.request: Assign every action to the CEO even though no owner was named.
negative_example.reason: The skill must not invent ownership.

name: inbox-negotiator
summary: Prepare evidence-aware email negotiation drafts and response options while keeping sending and commitments under explicit control.
avoid_when: the user has not authorized access to the thread
the response would make an unapproved legal financial or commercial commitment

positive_example.request: $inbox-negotiator draft three counteroffer options from this authorized email thread; do not send.

negative_example.request: Send acceptance of any price immediately.
negative_example.reason: Unapproved commercial commitments and automatic sending are prohibited.

name: personal-coo
summary: Maintain a bounded operating view of priorities, commitments, dependencies, and follow-through without silently taking control.
avoid_when: the user asks for emotional or clinical support
the system lacks authoritative calendars tasks or project state
workflow: propose the smallest next actions and confirmations

positive_example.request: Build a weekly operating review from my authorized task and calendar data.

negative_example.request: Take over my life and make every decision without asking.
negative_example.reason: The skill supports agency and explicit approval, not silent control.
